english.meaning: the way someone goes about doing something
english.note: 噉樣搞法 means doing it this way.

exampleSentences.english: So your factory can’t hire me? Is that how you do things?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉你間廠咪唔可以請我？噉樣搞法。
